headline: Red Sox wild card nerves and Patriots injury woes mount
morning_brew: It is a massive weekend at Fenway with the Royals in town, and we need the bats to wake up before this wild card hunt slips away completely. We are sitting in the second wild card spot with fifteen games remaining, but the cushion is shrinking by the hour and we cannot keep dropping games to teams below us in the standings. I am sick of watching us struggle to plate runs when the pressure hits, and tonight is the perfect opportunity to show that this team actually has the heart to grind out a postseason berth.

Football season is barely underway and we are already dealing with a major headache after learning A.J. Brown is heading to injured reserve. Losing a playmaker of that caliber for a stretch of games is a bitter pill to swallow, but the front office acted fast by bringing in DaQuan Jones to shore up the defensive front. I hope the coaching staff has a real plan to adjust the passing attack because we need to put that opening loss in the rearview mirror and start stacking wins before the schedule gets even tougher.

My neighbor Rick is convinced the IR stint is actually a tactical move to keep the league guessing, which is typical Rick nonsense, but I will be at the park tonight hoping for a win that takes the sting out of the week. We have been through enough heartbreak in this city to know that hope is a dangerous thing, yet here I am, checking the standings every five minutes like a nervous wreck. Let us see if we can get back to business and give the fans something to cheer about under the lights.
